claim: Over \(\mathbb F_2\), the largest order of a fooling-set matrix of rank at most four is exactly 11: \(f_{\mathbb F_2}(4)=11\).
integrity: The displayed lower-bound matrix is checked by exact binary arithmetic. The upper bound is replayed by a deterministic standard-library branch-and-bound maximum-clique verifier using proper-coloring bounds; no floating-point optimizer is used.
limitations: The upper bound is a finite exhaustive computation on a rigorously derived 120-vertex compatibility graph; no structural classification of all extremizers is claimed. The result is specific to the binary field, and an unindexed equivalent low-rank statement remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Exact binary rank-four fooling-set maximum
